headline: Ethics archives complaint against Juan Dász Dios for abuse
content: The Ethics Commission of Congress reversed its decision and archived the case involving lawmaker Juan José Dãsz Dios, accused by his wife of physical and psychological violence. The commission had previously decided last week to initiate proceedings on their own due to existing complaints filed at Monterrico police station by his spouse back in June. Yesterday, Congressman Mauricio Múlder requested dismissal of the investigation considering both the judiciarys archival of the file and the complainant Cinthya Morales Pastor’s withdrawal of charges. Entering private life matters seems excessive especially since neither Judiciary nor Public Ministry did, stated Congressman Múlder. Alongside Múlder voted legislators Carlos Túbino (Force Alliance) and Enrique Womng (Solidarity National). On the other hand, expressed opposition were congress members Roger Rojas Canche (Union Nationally) and Rúben Ramos (Win Peru). Rógelio Canche affirmed such action sets a negative precedent affecting Parliaments reputation and apologized towards women. Votes dictate outcomes. Three abstained while five supported initiating investigations given ethical concerns, he exclaimed. President of National Party, Nadine Heredia also criticized ethics agreement stating support came through friends, avoiding exemplary punishment. Thanks to Congress expenses and friends who protect others. Woman mistreatment accusation against Dâsz Dios was shelved thanks to allies, she wrote on Twitter. Responding, Force Populist congressman insisted cases were closed both legally and within Congress without habeas corpus and judge selection.

headline: Political parties didnt request technical assistance for internal elections
content: Only five political groups out of seventeen seeking presidential nominations for upcoming 2016 polls sought advice from ONPE. According to election authority information provided, guidance was offered to APRISTA party, Peruvians for Change, Action Popular, Humanist Party, and Democratic Unity. Other factions showed disinterest in utilizing experts’ help organizing internal votes. Deadline yesterday marked end date for selecting presidential and vice-presidential nominees. Registration deadline at JNE stands until January 11. Next step involves choosing congressional and Parliamentary Andean representatives concluding January 20. ONPE reminded parties need account number seats corresponding each electoral district along gender quota requirements.

headline: Prosecutor dismisses defense appeal regarding lifting immunity of Representative Rámirez
content: If proven otherwise about Rámirez we will stand firmly, won’t shield anyone, Keiko Fuji­mor­i declared during CADE 2015 event. Supreme Court evaluates whether to lift immunity of representative Rámirez. Superior Prosecutor dismissed defense plea made by lawyer representing former APRA member Congressman Joaqun Rámirez Gamarrа requesting annulment of prosecutors motion to revoke parliamentary immunity based upon ongoing legal actions initiated after allegations surfaced via public prosecution office following suspicious activities identified among relatives linked to money laundering offenses. Rámirez argued significant wealth increase occurred subsequent to being elected congressman in 2011. Defense appealed but faced rejection leading matter forwarded to criminal court awaiting Supreme Court ruling determining next steps including potential referral to Congress deciding fate of involved politician.

headline: Arresto frustrado de vendedora de droga provoca disturbios
content: Una mujer trató de evitar el arresto de un presunto vendedor de droga. Además de atacar a la policía, rompió el casco de un uniformado. Finalmente, fue detenida y llevada a la comisaría de Carmen de la Legua, y después al Ministerio Público.  Entre 2014 y 2015 se reportaron 344 casos de agresión a policías según Román, abogado de la Policía. Actualmente existen 40 personas en prisión por dicho delito.  Durante el último sábado, otra mujer agredió a una fiscal y a un policía mientras conducían ebria en Los Olivos. Sin embargo, la Fiscalía dejó libre a la implicada.

headline: Brasil espera sentencia para Eva Bracamonte en caso Félix Ferreyros
content: La Segunda Sala Penal con Reos en Cárcel emitirá veredicto el próximo martes 29 de diciembre en el juicio contra Eva Bracamonte por el homicidio de su madre, la empresaria Myryam Ferreyros. Durante su última declaración, Bracamonte insistió en su inocencia argumentando que esto me destrozó la vida.

headline: Senamhi advierte temperaturas altas debido al fenómeno climático NIÑO
content: Las temperaturas alcanzarán valores mayores a 30°C en Lima, indicó el director de Meteorología Síntomatica del SENAMHI, señalando también posibilidad de precipitaciones intensas especialmente en febrero. Distritos como La Molina y Ate experimentarán calor extremo.

headline: Remodelación del estadio de San Isidro prevé preparativos para Panamericanos
content: El estadio municipal será renovado para formar parte de las sedes de los próximos Juegos Panamericanos. Contará con infraestructuras avanzadas capaces de alojar eventos multideportivos, además de mejoras significativas en pistas atléticas y otras áreas recreacionales.

headline: Normalización del tráfico en Carretera Central tras paso de huaico
content: Después de bloqueos causados por un huaico, el flujo vehicular volvió a la normalidad en la Carretera Central. Restricciones adicionales afectarán el transporte de carga no perecedera durante ciertas festividades navideñas.

headline: Yeudy Simón critica campaña electoral y expresa preocupación por políticos corruptos
